title: Differentially Private Score Estimation with Applications to Score-Based Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25536v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating the score function of a distribution plays a central role in statistics and machine learning, with applications in distribution estimation, sampling, and score-based generative modeling. However, learning scores from sensitive data raises privacy concerns. These concerns are particularly pronounced in score-based generative modeling, where trained models may memorize individual training examples and expose sensitive information through membership inference and data extraction attacks.   Although non-private score estimation has been extensively studied, the statistical limits of its private counterpart remain less understood. In this work, we study score estimation under $(\alpha,\beta)$-differential privacy for $d$-dimensional sub-Gaussian distributions with locally $\gamma$-H\"older-continuous scores. translated_title: 差分隐私分数估计及其在基于分数的生成模型中的应用
translated_abstract: 估计一个分布的分数函数在统计学和机器学习中扮演着核心角色，其应用涵盖分布估计、采样以及基于分数的生成建模。然而，从敏感数据中学习分数会引发隐私问题。这些担忧在基于分数的生成建模中尤为突出，因为训练后的模型可能会记住个别训练样本，并通过成员推断和数据提取攻击泄露敏感信息。尽管非隐私的分数估计已被广泛研究，但其隐私版本（即隐私保护下的分数估计）的统计极限仍知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们研究了在 $(\alpha,\beta)$-差分隐私约束下，对具有局部 $\gamma$-Hölder 连续分数的 $d$ 维次高斯分布进行分数估计的问题。我们开发了一种基于采样的隐私分数估计器，该估计器使用了二次 B 样条和指数机制，并且我们实现了……
tldr: 本文研究了差分隐私约束下的分数估计问题，针对具有局部 Hölder 连续分数的次高斯分布，提出了一种基于二次 B 样条和指数机制的采样式隐私分数估计器，并将其应用于隐私保护的基于分数的生成模型。
en_tdlr: This paper studies score estimation under (α,β)-differential privacy for d-dimensional sub-Gaussian distributions with locally γ-Hölder-continuous scores, developing a sampling-based private score estimator using quadratic B-splines and the exponential mechanism, with applications to privacy-preserving score-based generative models.
